title: 第3章 蛇妖第4章 埋伏第5章 还债
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“呵呵，没想到你也看出来了，实不相瞒这个蛇精经常去我家骚扰我们，还咬死了我家的几头藏獒了，而且似乎它不惧怕子弹，好几次都被它逃走了。”
大少爷则解释道，他面色有点尴尬，他手下那么多保镖竟然干不过一个畜生。
“给我一百万，我帮你收了他。记住我认钱不认人，给我钱我帮你做事除妖，少一个子我绝不放过你。”
陈锋看了大少爷一眼，然后他伸出了一根手指，冷冷的道。
陈锋最恨拿钱不办事的人，以前他记得上学时候拜托过一个同学帮忙他打游戏练级，结果那同学拿了他的钱竟然不干活，他气的去找对方理论结果对方还把他打了一顿，这件事把他气的不行。
所以虽然这么多年过去了，但是陈锋想到那件事依旧不爽。
所以如今他才会对面前这个大少爷这么说话，想要办事，先给钱才行。
“什么？”
听到陈锋的话大少爷一愣，面有不悦之色，他不确定眼前的陈锋是否是骗子，拿了钱逃跑。
而且陈锋说话似乎一点都不客气，让他心里很不舒服。
而他身边的两个保镖则忍不住，其中高个子保镖用手指着陈锋叫嚣道：“你是江湖骗子吧，你在我们李少面前装什么，你什么态度呢？而且你看都没看就要一百万，我们怎么知道你是不是那蛇精的对手，万一你被蛇精吃了怎么办？要我看你一毛钱都不值。”
砰！
他话没说完，忽然陈锋起身抬手一巴掌抽在了他的脸上，顿时将这个保镖抽的飞了出去。
高个子保镖直接撞在了30米远的一棵树上，他将树桩都撞的断裂了，他本人倒在地上疼的哇哇大叫。。
“哥哥。”
看到这里，另外一个身材稍微矮一点的保镖大惊失色，他则直接扑了过去，用手将昏迷的保镖搀扶了起来。
原来这两个保镖是兄弟两人，被打晕的乃是哥哥，矮个子则是弟弟。
“蝼蚁一样的东西，我陈北玄也是你能够挑衅的？”
再看陈锋这边，在一巴掌抽飞对方后，陈锋则收回了手冷冷的道。
陈锋知道师傅走后将北玄仙尊封号赐予了自己，从下山的那一刻开始他代表的就是师傅，代表的就是北玄仙尊，正所谓仙尊不可辱，一个蝼蚁一样的小保镖也敢藐视他，那么自然是要拍飞的。

他没有杀对方，已经是手下留情了。
“老子杀了你，你敢打我哥哥。”
这个个子矮一点保镖忽然用手从身上摸出来一把手枪，然后对着陈锋扣动了扳机。
砰！
一声枪响，矮个子保镖的枪口冒出红色的火焰，子弹直接朝着陈锋射来。
不过面对射过来的子弹，陈锋不慌不忙，他右手翻开只见两指之间捏着一片叶子，屈指一弹。
嗤！
附带着他强大真气的树叶直接射了出来和子弹碰撞到了一起，然后树叶切开了子弹不说直接射到了保镖持枪的手上。
伴随着一阵惨叫声，保镖的手枪被直接切断，而且他的手指都被切下来三根，血流如注。
这个矮个子保镖躺在了地上，惨叫起来。
砰！
这还不说，那切开子弹和切断手枪和人手指的树叶余势不减，直接打在了后面的劳斯莱斯桥车上，打的整个车子都剧烈的颤动起来。
而树叶正牢牢地扎入了车门上。
而看到这里，那个大少爷惊呆了，他不敢相信。他慌忙走过去走到了劳斯莱斯面前，他想要手将扎入车门的树叶拔下来。可惜他费劲力气都拔不动，似乎这不是树叶，而是精钢制作而成的钢铁。
content_en:
"Haha, I didn't expect you to see it. To be honest, this snake spirit often comes to my house to harass us, and even killed several Tibetan mastiffs in my house. It seems that it is not afraid of bullets, and it escaped several times."
The eldest young master explained that he looked a little embarrassed because he had so many bodyguards but they couldn't kill one beast.
"Give me one million, and I will help you collect him. Remember, I recognize money but not people. Give me money and I will help you eliminate demons. I will never let you go if you lose a piece of money."
Chen Feng glanced at the eldest young master, then he stretched out a finger and said coldly.
Chen Feng hated people who took money and did nothing. In the past, he remembered that when he was in school, he asked a classmate to help him play games and level up, but the classmate took his money and refused to work. He angrily went to the other party to argue with him, but the other party beat him up. This incident made him extremely angry.
So even though so many years have passed, Chen Feng still feels unhappy when he thinks about that incident.
That's why he talks to the young master in front of him like this now. If he wants to do something, he must give him money first.
"What?"
The young master was stunned when he heard Chen Feng's words, with a displeased look on his face. He was not sure whether the Chen Feng in front of him was a liar and took the money and ran away.
Moreover, Chen Feng seemed not to be polite at all, which made him feel very uncomfortable.
The two bodyguards beside him couldn't help it. One of the tall bodyguards pointed his finger at Chen Feng and shouted: "You are a charlatan, what are you pretending to be in front of us, Mr. Li, and what is your attitude? And you asked for one million without even looking at it. How do we know if you are the opponent of the snake spirit? What if you are eaten by the snake spirit? You are not worth a dime to me."
Bang!
Before he finished speaking, Chen Feng suddenly stood up and slapped him on the face, sending the bodyguard flying away.
The tall bodyguard directly hit a tree 30 meters away. He hit the tree stump and broke it. He fell to the ground and screamed in pain. .
"Brother."
Seeing this, the other bodyguard, who was slightly shorter, was shocked. He rushed over and helped the unconscious bodyguard up with his hands.
It turned out that the two bodyguards were brothers. The one who was knocked unconscious was the elder brother, and the shorter one was the younger brother.
"I'm like an ant, and you can provoke me, Chen Beixuan?"
Looking at Chen Feng again, after slapping the opponent away with a slap, Chen Feng withdrew his hand and said coldly.
Chen Feng knew that his master had given him the title of Beixuan Immortal Lord after he left. From the moment he came down the mountain, he represented his master and Beixuan Immortal Lord. As the saying goes, the Immortal Lord cannot be insulted. If a little ant-like bodyguard dares to despise him, then he will naturally be shot away.
He didn't kill the other party, he was showing mercy.
"I'll kill you if you dare to hit my brother."
The shorter bodyguard suddenly took out a pistol from his body and pulled the trigger on Chen Feng.
Bang!
There was a gunshot, red flames erupted from the short bodyguard's gun, and the bullets shot directly towards Chen Feng.
However, in the face of the incoming bullets, Chen Feng remained calm. He opened his right hand and saw a leaf between his two fingers, and flicked it with one finger.
laugh!
The leaves carrying his powerful energy shot out and collided with the bullets. Then the leaves cut through the bullets and shot directly into the bodyguard's hand holding the gun.
Along with a scream, the bodyguard's pistol was cut off directly, and three of his fingers were cut off, bleeding profusely.
The short bodyguard lay on the ground and screamed.
Bang!
Not to mention, the leaves that cut bullets and amputated pistols and people's fingers continued unabated and hit the Rolls-Royce bridge behind, causing the entire car to shake violently.
The leaves were firmly embedded in the car door.
Seeing this, the young master was shocked, he couldn't believe it. He hurriedly walked over and walked to the Rolls-Royce. He wanted toUse your hands to pull out the leaves stuck in the car door. It's a pity that he couldn't pull it out despite all his efforts. It seemed that it was not a leaf, but steel made of fine steel.
